note: The named RAM fields the F14.14 harness (ADR-0238 sec. 3) turns into the JSON state a Jev Choice is asked over. Read with scripts/step_emu.py from the state scripts/stages/ninjagaiden/mint-stage1.txt writes (emulated frame 1083, lives $0076=2, Ryu x $0086=32, camera 0); the addresses and the fractional-word arithmetic are the ones scripts/route_search.py already steers a search by.

lives.note: verified on the minted state: reads 2, and the committed route loses none in 60 s

hp.note: verified on the minted state: reads 0x10 (16, the act's maximum)

ryu_screen_x.note: screen-relative: it stops at 128 once the camera follows Ryu

ryu_x.note: Ryu's x inside the screen, with its fractional byte

camera_x.note: signed high byte: walking left of the level start clamps it and the byte turns $FF

abs_x.note: the progress metric: Act 1-1 pins Ryu at 987 (camera 859) until a Left+A jump leaves the spot

ryu_state.note: the animation/action byte the harness reads as a coarse pose

enemies_near.note: how many of the eight enemy slots hold an id, so a question can say one is around
